name: Hana
who: Paints at home in Cairo and posts what she makes on Instagram. She names a shop only to say she has none, so no shop is built for her: she wants one place for what she has to do.
said: I'm Hana. I didn't run a shop; I only post on Instagram, and I want one place for my tasks.

says.plain: I'm Hana. I didn't run a shop; I only post on Instagram, and I want one place for my tasks.
says.hard: I'm Hana. I post what I paint on Instagram and forget what I said I would do this week.

first: Varnish the blue canvas before Friday

promises.says: nothing is saved until you keep it
